summary:
I reviewed A3 M4 at 04383d0 through the logic lens. It is not ready: one medium finding blocks it, and there are three low ones.

Medium (new in r2): on a phone, the target chips' tap areas now reach 14 px down over the stat row. A tap on the DMG, RATE, RANGE or PIERCE label changes her targeting, opens ⋯, or starts Set aim (Iroha).

Low:
- abilityRow's no-bolt fallback is undone on the next frame.
- Keyboard focus on a lock 'i' falls to the page on any redraw.
- The '13 numbers with HUD' line still needs the owner's ruling.

Co-op stays display only:
- The sim id is c22b2587f4b7, the same as e07e5e9, and COOP_PROTOCOL is still 8.
- M4 touches none of the 63 sim-id files and nothing in src/sim, src/data or src/online.
- Every drawer action goes through ctx.act. The per-frame stat paint only reads.

Earlier findings:
- Every earlier logic finding is fixed, except two partial lows: r1-4 (the lock 'i' case is left) and r1-3 (waiting on the owner).
- r1-2 is fixed for every measured name (closed, open and with a fallback font), but its new no-bolt fallback is broken (low).

What I tested in the browser, all passing:
- Keyboard: Space and Enter on a focused row, price, chip, ⋯, Sell and MORE never start the wave. Two Spaces or two Enters buy one tier. Escape closes without selling.
- Pointer: the 2.6 s arm and CONFIRM windows (timed in the page), two-tap buy, moving or dropping the arming, and Sell and Buy never armed together.
- The poor-row toast is 'Need 95 more coins.' (cost 100, coins 5). Sell gives the coins back and closes the drawer.
- Target chips, PRIORITY in use, the Auto switch, and FIRE wired to castAbility. A hero rally shows on the open drawer's stat row right away.
- Hero Level up, including the poor-coins toast. The hero widget hides and comes back.
- The ally drawer (read only, rows not focusable), and 13 numbers with Sango's ⚡ row open and a row armed.
- The 288 px side drawer at 667x375, and no state leaking across battles.
- No page errors. The only console error is this sandbox blocking Google Fonts.

The M4 harness passed at 844: m4-drawer-aoi, m4-drawer-armed (with key-space), m4-stat-live, m4-keys, m4-drawer-ally, m4-lock-why and m4-abname. tests/battle-ui plus tests/ui pass (52 files, 784 tests), and so does tests/tools/cssFloor.

Environment: the load average was 30–55 from other workflows. The full vitest run hit my 1700 s cap. Three long sim tests timed out at 694–938 s: smoke campaign sweep, perf.tenka and balance winnable. M4 changes no sim file. Steps that needed two round trips inside 2.6 s were redone inside the page.

findings.title: On phones the target chips' tap areas cover the top 14 px of the stat row: a tap on DMG / RATE / RANGE / PIERCE changes her target (or opens ⋯, or starts Set aim)
findings.where: src/ui/styles/battle.css:680 `.bt-panel .bt-tchip::after { top: 0; translate: none; }` (inside @media (max-height: 480px), added in 04383d08) with :413 (the ::after is var(--tap-dense) = 40 px tall) and :677 (chips 24 px tall); applies to every .bt-tchip in the drawer: target, strip, aim (AUTO / SET AIM), Midori's PICK / AUTO, Chika's flight chips
findings.evidence: probe2 at 844x390 and 667x375 (Aoi 3-0-1): sampling elementFromPoint down the middle of the stat row, its top 14 px of 39 px (844) and of 33 px (667) resolve to FIRST / LAST / STRONG / CLOSE / ⋯. A real touch tap 4 px into the stat row over the RATE label changed her target mode from first to strong at both sizes (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/bc8e90b4-5af0-5aad-ab54-4a98bb73399f/scratchpad/abil-m4/r2logic-b/out/probe2-844x390.json, probe2-667.log). Painting the hit areas shows them covering the whole caps-label line of the stat row: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/bc8e90b4-5af0-5aad-ab54-4a98bb73399f/scratchpad/abil-m4/r2logic-b/out/p4-hit-aoi-844x390.png; for Iroha the AUTO / SET AIM areas cover the DMG / RATE labels, so the same tap starts aim mode (p4-hit-iroha-844x390.png). Before r2 the centred 40 px area reached about 6 px into the row; r2 moved its top to the chip's top so it reaches about 14 px, the label line. The r2 commit treats the stat row as taking no taps, but players tap labels to learn them, and the drawer's own rule makes a tap there a 'tap elsewhere' (it disarms an open row). In co-op the mis-tap sends a tgt command. Nothing tests it: the UI probe's 'overlaps none' compares boxes, not hit areas.
findings.fix: Keep chip hit areas off other rows' content. For example make the stat row take its own taps (`.bt-panel .bt-dw-stats { position: relative; z-index: 1; }`) and give the chip rows the room another way (a 32 px row with the hit area centred, or the extra height taken from the gap above where the ⚡ row's FIRE is not), or end the ::after at the row gap. Add an e2e hit test at 844 and 667: every point of the stat row (and of the aim row's label) resolves to no control.

findings.title: abilityRow's 'no bolt' fallback is undone on the next frame (update() rewrites the row's className every frame)
findings.where: src/ui/battle/abilityRow.js:258 (fit adds bt-abrow-nobolt to el) vs :311 (update assigns el.className from state, open and fold only; towerPanel updateLive calls abRow.update(t) every frame)
findings.evidence: probe3 at 844 (Sango 0-3-0, a wide letter-spacing forced on her name, then a fonts 'loadingdone' event): the class log shows 'bt-abrow s-between bt-abrow-nobolt' at t=145471 ms, then 'bt-abrow s-between' at t=154649 (the next update); every later frame has the ⚡ shown again (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/bc8e90b4-5af0-5aad-ab54-4a98bb73399f/scratchpad/abil-m4/r2logic-b/out/probe3-844x390.json). With the fonts the e2e measures, no name needs the fallback (m4-abname: noBolt false for all six, nothing cut), so this only bites when even a name's longest word misses the two-line box. Names use Nunito from Google Fonts. Where that is blocked (as in this sandbox) the fallback font stays, and `.bt-panel .bt-abrow-name { overflow: visible }` would let the word run past its box toward FIRE. m4-abname logs noBolt but never asserts that it holds.
findings.fix: Keep the flag across updates. Store noBolt in fit() and add it to update()'s className, or toggle only the state classes with classList. In m4-abname, force a case that needs the fallback (letter-spacing) and assert that bt-abrow-nobolt is still set, and the name not cut, a few frames later.

findings.title: Keyboard focus on a lock 'i' (or a Buffing face) falls to the page on any redraw, so the next Space starts the wave (r1-4 fixed for ⋯ and MAX only)
findings.where: src/ui/battle/towerPanel.js focusKeyOf (:1110-1122): .bt-dw-info (crosspath and held-tier 'i') and .bt-buffing-face have no data-testid or data-mode, so it returns [] and render() restores nothing
findings.evidence: probe2 at 844 and 667: Tab, focus the crosspath row's 'i', then change the coins (a row's afford state flips, so the drawer redraws). document.activeElement becomes BODY (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/bc8e90b4-5af0-5aad-ab54-4a98bb73399f/scratchpad/abil-m4/r2logic-b/out/probe2-844x390.json 'i-focus-after-redraw'). Mid-wave this happens whenever a row becomes affordable. Between waves, the next Space then calls startWave.
findings.fix: Give the 'i' buttons stable keys (data-testid path-why-N / final-why-N) and the Buffing faces a data-uid, or fall back to the row's controls (rowOf) for any focused control inside a .bt-path.
